identification: Box of retro music CDs, two rows of jewel cases, roughly 100-150 discs (not exactly countable from photos). Mostly blues, blues-rock and 80s/90s rock/pop: Jeff Healey, Walter Trout, Johnny Winter, Stevie Ray Vaughan, Joe Satriani, Steve Vai, Peter Wolf, Pat Benatar, Bill Cosby, Eric Clapton, Simply Red, Diesel, Dynamic Hepnotics, Bobby Bland, Sam & Dave, Sheryl Crow, Tinsley Ellis, John Mayall, Van Halen, Keith Urban, U2 Best of 1980-90, Rod Stewart, Naxos Cinema Classics. Mainstream commercial pressings, no obvious rarities.

Andy should count the discs and flip through for anything out of print. Roughly 1-2 dollars per disc is the best case for eBay bulk lots; the sold prices are 0-2 years old and flat.
